newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CLUBS BOYCOTT RFU MEETING.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CLUBS BOYCOTT RFU MEETING.

text.p: Rugby Football Union executive committee chairman Cliff Brittle suffered the party host's ultimate nightmare on Tuesday.
None of England's top 24 clubs bothered to turn up to a meeting called at short notice by Brittle at the East India Club.
The union and the clubs have been at loggerheads over control of the game since it turned professional 18 months ago.
